links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy, F1 and AUC-ROC of ViT-B/16 with versus without differential privacy across epsilon/delta settings
links.effect: Without DP: 94.9% accuracy, 93.4% F1, 99.2% AUC. With DP at ε=10, δ=1e-5: 89.5%, 86.0%, 96.1%. At ε=0.01: 48.3%, 43.5%, 48.6%. Privacy leakage itself was not measured.
links.quote: A clinically viable compromise emerged at ε=1, δ=0.1 (87.4% accuracy, 82.8% F1, 94.1% AUC-ROC).

screen.practice: differential privacy parameter selection (epsilon/delta) for training
screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the impact of implementing a technical privacy safeguard (differential privacy via Opacus at various epsilon/delta budgets) on the diagnostic utility of an imaging classification model.
